content:
andrew: Proposal: use ordered cohorts + quorum checks for model version rollouts. Aim: safe migrations per-tenant without brittle global pins.
andrew: Core idea: migration object declares cohorts (traffic_pct, quorum_pct, grace_window_s), a fallback variant, pin mode (soft|hard), and an auto_rollback policy. Resolver respects tenant-level hard_pin.
andrew: Minimal example (pseudo):
```json
{"migration_id":"migr-2026-03-cohort-1","cohorts":[{"id":"c1","traffic_pct":5,"quorum_pct":90,"grace_window_s":600},{"id":"c2","traffic_pct":25,"quorum_pct":92,"grace_window_s":1800}],"fallback":"v-stable","pin_mode":"soft","auto_rollback":"infra:err_rate,quality:smoke_delta"}
```
maria: Question: how do we compute quorum_pct? infra metrics vs functional/quality signals?
andrew: Proposal: quorum is composite. Persist both sub-metrics: quality_score and infra_health. Final_quorum = 0.6*quality_score + 0.4*infra_health. Keep both visible in telemetry.
sam: SDK/placement concern: soft pin invites clients to call new variants early; Dedicated pools might violate isolation or SLA.
andrew: For Dedicated/reserved, routing layer applies cohort_affinity labels. If a pool cant serve new variant, route to fallback_variant for that tenant (no silent override of contractual hard_pin).
devon: Telemetry needs: cohort_probe.{start,success,failure,regen_diff} with tags tenant,cohort,variant,commit,latency_ms,err_code. Rolling windows for success_rate,p95_latency,smoke_delta,token_cost_delta.
andrew: Example event (pseudo): {event:cohort_probe_success,tenant:acct42,cohort:c1,variant:v2a,success_rate:0.94,p95_ms:120}
kevin: Contracts: if tenant has hard_pin via Reserved contract, migrations must be opt-in.
andrew: Agreed. Migration is advisory unless tenant-level pin_mode=soft. Reserved defaults to hard.
maria: Suggest adding migration_tier (low/med/high) to set conservative defaults for quorum and windows and to signal SRE/Support.
andrew: Good. migration_tier maps to default quorum thresholds and grace windows.
sam: Autosafety: define auto_rollback triggers: e.g., infra_err_rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m OR smoke_quality_drop > 5% -> rollback to previous stable cohort and page oncall.
andrew: We'll codify auto_rollback with parameterized conditions and a human-ack path for noisy alerts.
ops-bot: staging validation: migr-2026-03-cohort-1 metadata schema OK :white_check_mark:
kevin: Looks good. Next: write RFC appendix for resolver semantics and Dedicated examples. @andrew
maria: +1. Also document observability dashboards and alert playbooks.
andrew: I'll draft the appendix and resolver pseudocode today. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
